interpretation: Previously observed V2 capture; not an independent holdout. Synthetic PASS is not independent recognition evidence. A candidate only warrants separate future validation, never production approval.

policyDefinitions.S1: In ARMED/CANDIDATE, allow the existing enter run also for a usable REACQUIRED_NOT_READY side. First fresh high-Y frame starts a provisional candidate; confirmation requires the unchanged 50ms continuously observed post-loss run. Do not add a second dwell, do not mark tracking READY, do not alter WAIT_RETURN or arbitration. Existing loss/gap reset discards old run, previous evidence and epoch.
policyDefinitions.S2: WAIT_RETURN rearms only after BOTH usable sides have absY < .25 continuously for the same 100ms observed overlap after the event. Any unusable/nonclear side or gap resets this joint return run. No changes to entry/reacquisition/WAIT_CLEAR.
